commands.name: modscope
commands.description: Debug the session's loaded mods: failures, stats, sources, diagnosis.
commands.output:
modscope report — 0 mods seen, 0 recorded failures


/modscope mods · errors · events · slow · pane · validate · fix <name>

tools.name: list_mods
tools.description: List the mods (plugins with hooks modules) loaded in this Claude Code session: name, version, root directory, tier, provenance, and the host-scanned list of the events each one hooks and the engine calls it makes — the same data `claude plugin validate` prints. Use to inspect which mods are installed and what each one can touch.

tools.name: mod_errors
tools.description: Recent hook failures observed across the session's loaded mods — throws, budget timeouts, post-next failures and rejections — attributed to the plugin that caused them, with the event, outcome, wall time and a preview of the event input. Use to find which mod is misbehaving.

tools.name: mod_stats
tools.description: Event and plugin timing statistics gathered by wrapping every engine dispatch: event counts and failure counts, plus total hook wall time per plugin (slowest mods first).

tools.name: read_mod
tools.description: Read a loaded mod's own files — its hooks/hooks.json manifest and each hooks module it declares — to inspect or debug its source code.

tools.name: validate_mod
tools.description: Run `claude plugin validate` on a loaded mod's directory and return the report: the hook registrations and engine calls its source is scanned as using.
